

<!-----

% mathbf: 
%  Produces bold, upright (roman) characters.
%  Only works reliably on Latin letters (A-Z, a-z) and a few uppercase Greek letters
% 
% boldsymbol
%  Preserves the original italic or slant shape of the math symbol while making it bold.
%  Works on Latin letters, Greek letters (both upper and lower case), 
%    and most mathematical symbols (like \alpha, \nabla, \times).


----->


\newcommand{\be}{\mathbf{e}}
\newcommand{\bx}{\mathbf{x}}
\newcommand{\by}{\mathbf{y}}
\newcommand{\bz}{\mathbf{z}}

\newcommand{\bX}{\mathbf{X}}
\newcommand{\bY}{\mathbf{Y}}
\newcommand{\bZ}{\mathbf{Z}}

\newcommand{\bfone}{\mathbf{1}}
